name: Kwame Mensah
intro: I’m Kwame Mensah, from Rwanda. My research interests are in machine learning theory and information extraction, particularly generalization, optimization, named entity recognition, and relation extraction. I enjoy connecting mathematical ideas with small, reproducible experiments and studying how to extract reliable structured information from text.
